capabilities: Convert the active note's outline into a task list
Insert the task list at the cursor position
Insert the task list in a new note via command palette commands
extras: README only documents the two command palette commands and does not show example output or explain how the outline is transformed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note's outline (headings) into a checklist-style task list.
summary: Plugin that converts the heading outline of the active note into a Markdown task list, either at the cursor or in a new note.
